title: still present since round 3: mark_opened doc claims an idempotent Submitted->UnderReview transition but applies it to any status
detail: change_status has no status guard, so the store-side 'idempotent' open transition fires on any current status; idempotency rests entirely on the dispatch-layer open_dispatched set. Third consecutive round.
recommended_fix: In change_status (or a mark_opened wrapper) transition only when the current status is Submitted; otherwise leave the store unchanged.

title: still present since round 3: create_vacancy derives the id from an 8-char-truncated name slug with no uniqueness check
detail: Two demo-created vacancies whose property names share an 8-char cleaned prefix get the same id; the second silently overwrites the first in store lookups. The id_suffix doc was fixed, the collision was not. Third round.
recommended_fix: Append a disambiguator (store vacancy count or sequence) to the suffix, or extend the suffix until it is unique within the store.

title: still present since round 3: send_reminder / remind_applicant / send_bulk_invite mutate nothing and return canned counts that contradict the seeded awaiting list
evidence:
pub fn send_reminder(
  store: DemoStore,
  _vacancy_id: String,
) -> #(DemoStore, #(Int, Int)) {
  #(store, #(2, 1))
}
... and ...
  BulkInviteResult(
      sent: 2,
      invalid: 1,
      invalid_emails: ["bad@example.ie"],
      trimmed: 0,
    )
... and demo_api.gleam ...
  let #(next, result) = demo_store.send_reminder(store, vacancy_id)
  let _ = next
  deliver(on_response, result)
detail: v-maples' static_awaiting has exactly 1 unreminded row (Emma Doyle) yet send_reminder reports #(2, 1); bulk-invite ignores the typed emails and always returns bad@example.ie. The demo teaches an outcome that never happened. Third round.
recommended_fix: Compute reminder counts from static_awaiting and flip reminded/followed_up; parse the submitted emails for the bulk-invite result instead of the canned BulkInviteResult.

title: still present since round 3: vacancy/status mutations return Ok unconditionally - nonexistent ids report success; the Result error channel is dead
evidence:
#(DemoStore(..store, vacancies: updated), Ok(vacancy_id))
... (archive_vacancy:1245, restore_vacancy:1259, close_vacancy:1273) and change_status:1345 ...
  #(DemoStore(..store, vacancies: updated), Ok(slug))
detail: The list.map no-ops when no vacancy/application matches yet Ok is returned; callers cannot distinguish a miss from a mutation, and the Result type on these signatures is decoration. Third round.
recommended_fix: Check the match after the map and return Error on miss, or drop the Result from these signatures and simplify demo_api.respond_result.

title: still present since round 3 (mutated form): demo_not_in_demo_toast's off-by-one id allocation still collides with add_toast - one timeout dismisses both
evidence:
let toast_id = model.next_toast_id + 1
  #(
    Model(
      ..model,
      toasts: list.append(model.toasts, [
        model.Toast(id: toast_id, message:, level: model.ToastInfo),
      ]),
      next_toast_id: toast_id,
    ),
... vs add_toast ...
  let id = model.next_toast_id
  ...
  #(Model(..model, toasts: capped_toasts, next_toast_id: id + 1), dismiss_eff)
detail: add_toast's invariant is next_toast_id = next UNUSED id (id := next, next := id+1). The demo helper issues id = next+1 and stores next := that id, so the very next add_toast reuses the demo toast's still-visible id; AppDismissToast filters by id, so the demo toast's 5s timer kills both. Third round.
recommended_fix: Use add_toast's convention exactly: let id = model.next_toast_id, then next_toast_id: id + 1 (or route through a shared toast helper).

title: still present since round 3 (half-fixed): download_timeout duplicated between client.gleam and demo_update.gleam with divergent signatures; store_of is now deduplicated
detail: store_of was unified (client.gleam:5919 demo_store_of delegates to demo_update.store_of), but the two download_timeout bodies remain duplicated with divergent signatures. Third round.

title: still present since round 3: status_from_slug silently coerces any unknown status slug to Submitted
detail: A typo in a demo action wire silently lands as Submitted rather than failing loudly; change_status trusts the result. Third round.
recommended_fix: Return a Result from status_from_slug (or panic on unknown slugs - demo-only code) so a bad slug fails the test suite instead of corrupting demo state.

title: still present since round 3 (partial fix): refcheck pins are store-level only - the r3-asked dispatch-level UserSavedRefcheckEdit substitute pin never landed, and start/take_over/correct stay unpinned
detail: The r3 warning asked for store-level tests for each apply_refcheck branch PLUS one dispatch-level substitute test. Only skip + re_enable + substitute are pinned, all by calling demo_store directly - reverting the demo_update arm's typed-trio threading (fire_demo_refcheck_substitute) or its validation stays green.
recommended_fix: Add one client.update(UserSavedRefcheckEdit(call_id)) dispatch test with RefcheckEditSubstitute asserting the typed contact lands in model.demo_store.

title: still present since round 3: fetch_leaderboard_page ignores its page parameter
detail: The _page parameter is discarded; latent today (load-more hidden in demo) but a future demo surface that pages would silently receive page 1 every time. Third round.
recommended_fix: Slice the leaderboard entries by page, or drop the parameter and the fetch_leaderboard wrapper indirection.
